traits.label: MOOD
traits.title: 冷静的工程自信
traits.body: 近黑舞台、低饱和蓝光和充足留白，让复杂 Agent 平台显得可控，而非炫技。

traits.label: COMPOSITION
traits.title: 中心舞台 + 边缘证据
traits.body: 首屏把生命周期概念放在中轴；UI、logo 与数据退到边缘，形成清晰的视觉优先级。

traits.label: TYPE
traits.title: 轻、宽、少层级
traits.body: 大字号粗体标题配简短副句；导航安静退后，平台段落用 H3/H4 清晰分层。

traits.label: COLOR
traits.title: 蓝只作为信号
traits.body: 冷蓝服务于标题光感、状态与路径；大面积保持近黑，OSS 段落切到白底重置可读性。

traits.label: EVIDENCE
traits.title: 真实 UI 代替插画
traits.body: trace、图表、表格、客户 logo 与硬数据成为品牌视觉素材，同时承担可信度解释。

traits.label: RHYTHM
traits.title: 叙事像一条生命周期
traits.body: 定位 → 背书 → 平台能力 → 开源框架 → 客户故事 → 量化规模 → 转化收尾，每屏推进一个认知动作。

seed.visualDirection: 深色、低噪声的工程舞台；以冷蓝作为稀缺信号，以真实运行界面取代装饰插画。
seed.dos: 保留中轴留白、让产品证据可读、用 sticky rail 组织长平台叙事、深浅段落交替。
seed.donts: 不要泛滥渐变、玻璃卡片、无意义 3D 图形，或复制 LangChain 专有图形与 logo。

annotations.label: Centered hero hierarchy
annotations.body: Single-column hero: glowing headline → subhead → dual CTAs → abstract lifecycle diagram (Build/Test/Deploy/Monitor). Nav stays peripheral; value prop owns the vertical center.

annotations.label: Dark canvas + luminous accent
annotations.body: Near-black navy ground with white ink and cyan-blue glow on the headline. Primary CTA inverts to white fill; secondary stays ghost — accent reads as light, not a flat brand block.

annotations.label: Lifecycle metaphor in hero
annotations.body: Abstract curved paths with labeled stages replace a product screenshot above the fold — process framing before capability depth.

annotations.label: Sticky platform rail
annotations.body: Left vertical rail lists Engine / Observability / Evaluation / Deployment / Fleet with active-state dot — scroll-synced chapter navigation for a long product story.

annotations.label: Product UI as proof
annotations.body: Each platform beat pairs copy with a real LangSmith UI capture (issues, traces, eval charts) — credibility via literal product chrome, not abstract icons alone.

annotations.label: Dark product band density
annotations.body: Moderate density: H4 + paragraph + bullet list + outbound pill link; UI mock in rounded container with subtle border — readable without card grid clutter.

annotations.label: Light-band alternation
annotations.body: Page shifts to white canvas for OSS frameworks — dark→light rhythm resets legibility and signals a new narrative beat (open source vs platform).

annotations.label: Three-card framework grid
annotations.body: Equal-width cards with diagram thumbnail → icon → title → one-line posture → explore link. Parallel choices, not a carousel.

annotations.label: Operational subcopy on light
annotations.body: On white bands, headings stay bold sans; body copy tightens to product-fit one-liners — lower drama than hero display type.

annotations.label: Quantified community scale
annotations.body: Large-number stats (100M+ downloads, 6K+ customers, Fortune 10) on dark band — hard metrics after product depth.

annotations.label: Closing conversion beat
annotations.body: Final dark band repeats dual CTAs with dot-matrix wordmark texture — bookends hero geometry for narrative closure.

annotations.label: Footer as sitemap
annotations.body: Three-column link grid + newsletter on light footer; oversized outline logotype as ambient brand mark — utility over decoration.

transferableRules.rule: Lead dev-platform landings with a lifecycle or workflow metaphor before showing dense product UI.
Use dark canvas + one luminous accent on headline/key diagram; alternate to light bands for long-scroll readability.
Pair filled primary pill CTA with ghost secondary CTA of identical geometry.
Sequence credibility: hero promise → platform modules (UI proof) → OSS/framework cards → customer carousel → quantified stats → demo CTA.
Scroll-synced sidebar rail beats animating every section on developer marketing pages.
Do not copy LangChain logomark, glow illustration, lifecycle graphic, or customer logos.
